craft_notes: Sthāyin: utkrānti unit 14. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: By this sequential yoga, yoked, libation-abandoned: even the samayin g
oes to that initiation — thus in the Mālinī doctrine.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anena kramayogena yojito hutivarjitaḥ samayyapyeti tāṃ dīkṣāmiti śrīmālinīmate
